entries.title: Mark 16:1
segments: Anoint him; it was customary to anoint and embalm dead bodies in order to preserve them. 1-8. The resurrection.

entries.title: Mark 16:3
segments: When men love the Saviour and wish to honor him, they will often meet with difficulties. But if obstructed in one way, let them honor him in another; in due time apparently insurmountable obstacles may be in unexpected ways removed.

entries.title: Mark 16:7
segments: Though the friends of Christ may have deserted and even denied him, yet when they repent and turn to him he freely forgives them, and delights in removing their sorrows and promoting their joys.

entries.title: Mark 16:11
segments: Believed not; this shows, that notwithstanding all our Lord had said concerning his rising from the dead on the third day, his disciples did not expect it.

entries.title: Mark 16:12
segments: Another form; one different from that in which he had appeared before. Lk 24:13-31|.

entries.title: Mark 16:13
segments: The residue; those disciples who remained at Jerusalem.

entries.title: Mark 16:14
segments: The eleven; the eleven apostles. Judas having hung himself. Upbraided them; sharply rebuked them for their unbelief, in not receiving the testimony of those who had seen him after his resurrection. To reject competent evidence in matters of religion, is a great sin. It shows unbelief and hardness of heart, which are exceedingly offensive to God. Without faith in what he has revealed, it is impossible to please him.

entries.title: Mark 16:15
segments: All the world; wherever men are found. Preach the gospel; proclaim the glad tidings of salvation through repentance of sin, and faith in Jesus Christ. Every creature; every human being who can hear and understand it. It is the will of Christ that the gospel should be preached to all men. By repenting of sin and believing in him all may obtain it; and if they do not, they will, by their neglect, be self-destroyers.

entries.title: Mark 16:16
segments: He that believeth; receives the testimony of God, and treats it, in his feelings and conduct, as true. Is baptized; expresses his belief in God's testimony concerning his Son, not in words only, but in actions, according to Christ's directions. Shall be saved; saved from the practice and consequences of sin; inclined and enabled to practise holiness, and to continue in it, till, through grace, he is prepared for, and raised to the eternal holiness and bliss of heaven. Believeth not; does not so credit the testimony of God, especially in regard to his Son, and the way of life through him, as to love and obey him. Shall be damned; shall be left in the love and practice of sin through time, and be miserable to eternity. Though salvation through Christ should be preached to all men, yet none, without believing on and obeying him, will be saved.

entries.title: Mark 16:17
segments: In my name; in reliance on my power, and making it known that it is I, and not they, who perform the miracles.
. Speak with new tongues; in languages which they had not before known.

entries.title: Mark 16:18
segments: Serpents; poisonous reptiles. They would be able, when needful, to handle them without injury.
. Deadly thing; mortal poison. Lay hands on the sick,

entries.title: Mark 16:19
segments: . Right hand of God; a phrase denoting great exaltation and honor. As God has shown by the most conclusive evidence the truth of his gospel, those who continue to reject it are without excuse, and will perish with an awfully aggravated destruction.

entries.title: Mark 16:20
segments: The Lord working with them; by miracles, showing that they were sent of him; by removing obstacles, and giving them access to men: by accompanying the proclamation of his truth with his own power, and causing it to produce divine effects.
